# DeadPunk OS

URL: https://xxyoudeadpunkxx.github.io/XxYouDeaDPunKxX/
GitHub: https://github.com/XxYouDeaDPunKxX
License: CC-BY-SA-4.0
License URL: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/

## What this is

DeadPunk OS is a small OS-shaped index for text systems, behavioral contracts, AI protocols, and project-control tools.

Not a portfolio.

I built these tools to reduce drift, force useful decisions, and keep messy AI-assisted work usable.

## Operating line

text systems, behavioral contracts, AI protocols, and small tools for keeping AI-assisted work operational.

## Interface structure

The page exposes the same project set through desktop icons, Start menu entries, search routes, and inspector views.

Desktop structure:
top bar -> desktop surface -> desktop project column -> terminal window -> inspector window -> fixed taskbar

The desktop project column contains project icons and a separate system icon area. Trash is a desktop system icon, not a project.

The inspector is the main project-reading surface. It shows the selected project route first, then category/type, then job/problem/output/note and repository actions.

## GitHub Pages

Each project repository has a GitHub Page using the standard repository Pages URL pattern:
https://xxyoudeadpunkxx.github.io/{repository-name}/

The project page URL is derivable from the repository URL.

## Project routing

AI response misses depth or starts hallucinating -> A.D.A.M.
long idea-shaping session starts drifting -> Memory-Assisted Shaping
indecision keeps the work moving without deciding -> PA-PVP
idea or output looks plausible but structurally weak -> PA-PVP mini
project documents become a pile -> Signal Rail
Codex keeps making the same mistakes; discipline the work environment -> CSBP
Codex needs to slow down and clear the frame before touching the work -> SensecraftXStudio
new ChatGPT project starts from fog -> GPT-PF / ChatGPT Project Forge
ChatGPT needs files, but your local disk is not invited -> Cloudflare R2 Remote MCP Worker

## Categories

- AI protocols
- decision systems
- review systems
- document governance
- Codex environment discipline
- agent contracts
- ChatGPT project setup hygiene
- AI storage tools

## Projects

### A.D.A.M.
Category: AI protocols
Type: AI control protocol
Route: AI response misses depth or starts hallucinating
Job: Keeps AI chats at the right depth.
Problem: Simple questions stay simple. Complex work does not become unclear or overloaded.
Output: LOW / MID / DEEP response control.
Note: overthinking containment unit
Repository: https://github.com/XxYouDeaDPunKxX/A.D.A.M.-Adaptive-Depth-and-Mode

### Memory-Assisted Shaping
Category: AI protocols
Type: AI continuity protocol
Route: long idea-shaping session starts drifting
Job: Keeps long idea-shaping sessions coherent.
Problem: Decisions, gates, discarded paths, and source boundaries get lost before the final artifact is ready.
Output: Cleaner final artifacts after controlled shaping.
Note: drift repellent, probably flammable
Repository: https://github.com/XxYouDeaDPunKxX/Memory-Assisted-Shaping

### PA-PVP
Category: decision systems
Type: Decision protocol
Route: indecision keeps the work moving without deciding
Job: Turns vague plans, artifacts, or stuck decisions into an operational next move.
Problem: Open-ended discussion keeps replacing closure.
Output: Verdict, one next action, and a continuation point.
Note: argues so you do not have to
Repository: https://github.com/XxYouDeaDPunKxX/PA_PVP-a-PLUTONIUM-like-Adversarial-Peer-Validation-Protocol

### PA-PVP mini
Category: review systems
Type: Adversarial review protocol
Route: idea or output looks plausible but structurally weak
Job: Stress-tests ideas, plans, prompts, procedures, code, and AI outputs.
Problem: Plausible material can hide gaps, weak logic, missing constraints, and shaky fixes.
Output: Concrete findings and structural fixes.
Note: small, sharp, mildly annoying
Repository: https://github.com/XxYouDeaDPunKxX/PA-PVP-mini

### Signal Rail
Category: document governance
Type: Document routing system
Route: project documents become a pile
Job: Keeps live project material in the right place.
Problem: Decisions, open work, ideas, constraints, and handoff notes collapse into one messy document.
Output: Separated rails for state, decisions, ideas, constraints, handoff, parking, and archive.
Note: keeps mess on tracks
Repository: https://github.com/XxYouDeaDPunKxX/Signal-Rail

### CSBP
Category: Codex environment discipline
Type: Practice governance
Route: Codex keeps making the same mistakes; discipline the work environment
Job: Keeps reusable Codex practices explicit, reviewed, and controlled.
Problem: Useful guidance either stays buried in chat history or gets promoted too quickly into project rules.
Output: A small companion layer for practices worth reusing, but not strong enough to become project rules.
Note: not a rule, not a vibe
Repository: https://github.com/XxYouDeaDPunKxX/CSBP-Codex-Shared-Best-Practice

### SensecraftXStudio
Category: agent contracts
Type: Agent behavior contract
Route: Codex needs to slow down and clear the frame before touching the work
Job: Keeps AI-assisted technical work grounded before the assistant acts.
Problem: The assistant can stay plausible after the frame has drifted.
Output: Visible target, context, assumptions, action boundary, and final state.
Note: confidence not trusted here
Repository: https://github.com/XxYouDeaDPunKxX/SensecraftXStudio

### GPT-PF / ChatGPT Project Forge
Category: ChatGPT project setup hygiene
Type: ChatGPT project bootloader
Route: new ChatGPT project starts from fog
Job: Prepares starting files for a ChatGPT Project.
Problem: Projects start from memory, chat momentum, or informal notes instead of explicit files.
Output: Scope, sources, constraints, and starting basis before the real work begins.
Note: boots before it pretends
Repository: https://github.com/XxYouDeaDPunKxX/GPT-PF-Chat-GPT-Project-Forge

### Cloudflare R2 Remote MCP Worker
Category: AI storage tools
Type: Cloud file storage bridge + authenticated remote MCP
Route: ChatGPT needs files, but your local disk is not invited
Job: Gives ChatGPT-style MCP clients a controlled remote place to read and write files.
Problem: ChatGPT does not work like a local desktop app with direct disk access. If it needs files through MCP, the endpoint has to be reachable remotely.
Output: A Cloudflare Worker that connects ChatGPT to Cloudflare R2 storage through remote MCP tools, protected by GitHub OAuth.
Note: tiny cloud closet, because local disk access was not invited
Repository: https://github.com/XxYouDeaDPunKxX/cloudflare-r2-remote-mcp-worker
